Tooltip_IKST_ShopTerminalKit: Assemble from 2 planks, 4 nails, and 1 scrap metal (Crafting menu, no skill). Place on the ground, then Economy > Open my shop here.
Tooltip_IKST_AtmTerminalKit: Admin only — no craft recipe. Places a vanilla ATM kiosk (same as gas stations). Map ATMs already work without a kit.
Tooltip_IKST_WalletCraft: Craft a simple wallet to store Base.Money bills. Cash in your wallet drops on death with your corpse; bank balance stays safe.
